text: Hi, this is Daniel from the Oliveira project. I just saw the new drawings and I have a question. The kitchen looks smaller than the one we agreed on last month. I am not angry, I just want to understand what happened before I show this to my wife. Could you call me back today and walk me through it? Thanks.
Our supplier could not deliver the glass on time.
The client had already approved the first plan.
It stays inside the same budget.
We had to change the back wall.
That happened because of the supplier.
The good news is it stays inside the budget.
Instead of the special glass, we can use another one.
That way, we only lose four days.
